title: Shopify removes priceRule from DraftOrderDiscountNotAppliedWarning in API version 2026-10
summary: As of Admin API version 2026-10, the deprecated priceRule field on DraftOrderDiscountNotAppliedWarning (returned by draftOrderCalculate, draftOrderCreate and draftOrderUpdate) is removed, and with it the PriceRule object from the public schema.
migrationNote: Select discountTitle instead of priceRule { title } and discountCode instead of priceRule { discountCodes { nodes { code } } } on DraftOrderDiscountNotAppliedWarning.
